name: Morse.grassmannian
why: The project uses Hermitian idempotents with trace m, the blind Hermitian idempotents of rank m; for an idempotent, rank = trace (trace of a projection is the dimension of its range, Mathlib's IsProj.trace), so the two sets are equal (layer-1 glue V14_26 generalised from Fin k to any ι).
